## Message

```
[X18N5003] Reviews are not available <detail>
├▶ fix: Set `review.enabled` to true, and fix the review file if x18n reports it.
╰▶ see: https://x18n.antfu.dev/errors/x18n5003
```

The CLI prints the code and why the error happened, with details such as a file name or a field. The fix and a link to this page follow. With `--json`, the same parts are in `errors` of the [envelope](/references/json-contracts).

## What to do

A review command ran, but the project cannot write reviews. The message says why:

- `review.enabled` is `false` in the config.
- The review file could not be read (see [X18N5001](/errors/x18n5001)).

## Exit code

The CLI exits with code `1`.
